description: Conan v3 — 'leverage everything Claude Code can do.' Multi-project (global ~/.claude hook so any claude run self-reports; UI filters by cwd); nav expands to Overview/Agents/Skills/Settings; built on a real shadcn foundation. Surfaces broad Claude Code data from disk + CLI: real /usage via PTY scrape, settings mirror, MCP from ~/.claude.json, changelog feed, checkpoints (file-history), per-project metrics, plugins, custom agents, background agents, subagent reconstruction, prompt history, skills. Plus drive-flag expansion (effort/fork/from-pr/worktree/json-schema/ultrareview) and UX refinements (widget carousel+scope+sticky, sort toggle, term dropdown name+id, non-destructive show/hide, cwd picker, toasts). Builds on v1+v2 (Express+WS :3747, Vite+React 19 SPA, Tailwind v4, SQLite). Source backlog + research verdicts: docs/v3-backlog.md.

userStories.title: shadcn foundation — init deps, components.json, cn(), core primitives
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shadcn properly installed so v3's dropdown/control-heavy UI builds on accessible primitives instead of bespoke divs.
acceptanceCriteria: Install shadcn deps (class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, lucide-react, radix primitives, cmdk) and add components.json configured for React 19 + Tailwind v4 (use render not asChild)
Add lib/utils cn() helper; map existing semantic tokens to shadcn's so current theming (light+dark) carries over with no visual regression
Add core primitives under components/ui/: button, dropdown-menu, popover, tooltip, select, switch, tabs, badge, card, dialog, command
Existing app still builds and renders unchanged (no regression)
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill
userStories.notes: v1/v2 never actually installed shadcn (no components.json/cn/radix) — only used shadcn-compatible tokens. See docs/v3-backlog.md item 20. Suggested skills: shadcn, automate-browser.

userStories.title: Real /usage via PTY scrape — planUtilization on /api/claude/usage
userStories.description: As a Claude Max user, I want the real plan-utilization % and reset times surfaced, not just an approximation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a controlled PTY probe: spawn a claude node-pty session, send /usage, capture the rendered frame, strip ANSI, parse the five_hour and seven_day windows ({utilizationPct, resetAt}) + status

Extend /api/claude/usage with planUtilization: { fiveHour:{pct,resetAt}, sevenDay:{pct,resetAt}, status, probedAt }; cache the last probe; probe lazily (on demand / when dashboard open), not on a tight timer
Falls back to the existing US-004 token-trend baseline + reactive rateLimited/resetAt when no fresh scrape; never throws if the scrape fails
Probe is bounded (timeout, killed after capture) and does not leave stray ptys
Tests pass (parser unit-tested against a captured sample frame)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: RESEARCH: --debug api log does NOT expose ratelimit-unified headers (live-tested). PTY scrape of /usage is the only confirmed real source. v3-backlog item 2.
